WITH ins_p AS (
                    INSERT INTO projects.projects
                        (project_path, display_name, first_seen, last_seen)
                    SELECT $2, $2, NOW(), NOW()
                    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM projects.projects WHERE project_path = $2
                    )
                    RETURNING id
                ), pid AS (
                    SELECT id FROM ins_p
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT id FROM projects.projects WHERE project_path = $2
                    LIMIT 1
                ), s AS (
                    INSERT INTO sessions.sessions
                        (session_uuid, project_id, first_seen, last_seen)
                    SELECT $1::text::uuid, pid.id, NOW(), NOW() FROM pid
                    ON CONFLICT (session_uuid) DO NOTHING
                    RETURNING id
                )
                SELECT id AS "id!" FROM s
                UNION ALL
                SELECT id FROM sessions.sessions WHERE session_uuid = $1::text::uuid
                LIMIT 1
